name: Invoice Butler
description: Connect Claude to your Invoice Butler account to read customers, invoices, AR aging, and activity timelines in real time. This connector is read-only and OAuth-secured, so Claude can answer collections questions without modifying your data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Invoice Butler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Invoice Butler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.invoicebutler.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Invoice Butler MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Invoice Butler provides these MCP tools: get_ar_aging, get_customer, get_customer_contacts, get_customer_stats, get_customer_tags, get_customer_timeline, get_dashboard_metrics, get_top_overdue_customers, list_customers, list_invoices, and list_tag_vocabulary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Invoice Butler?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Invoice Butler in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Invoice Butler MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Invoice Butler requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Invoice Butler is developed by Invoice Butler. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
